title: AI Agent Lab
desc: An agent knowledge center built on the ChatBot: the left pane chats with an agent-knowledge backend (showcasing tool cards and the thinking strip), while the right pane curates mainstream frontend / backend / protocol / framework knowledge, a framework comparison and ready-to-use prompt templates.
chatSubtitle: Agent KB connected · tool cards & thinking strip
rec4: How to write a ReAct prompt
searchPlaceholder: Search topics, e.g. MCP, RAG, streaming…
copyFail: Copy failed — please copy the text manually
labHintStream: Three mainstream streaming channels play the same copy side by side — start / stop / reset anytime; the matrix below summarizes the trade-offs.
labHintRender: One answer, three render strategies: all-at-once, char-by-char and word-by-word typewriter.
labHintThink: Three forms of reasoning UI mapped to the answer lifecycle: live pulse while running, step strip after finish, full timeline audit.
